text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Special Week gets an offer to be interviewed for a magazine.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: How do I look, Trainer? Is my skirt on straight?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wearing my signature racewear outside of a race feels kinda weird.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I won't be running, but I'm still all fired up for some reason.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I know how you feel. The only time you put on your signature racewear is when you're ready for battle.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah, just putting it on gets me in a serious mood!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I hope I don't hype myself up too much and end up making strange faces during the interview…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: By the way, why aren't Sei, Grass, and El here yet?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: They've still got time. We're just here early.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I guess I'm just too excited to sit still!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You're the star here, so you need to act like one. Behold my majestic presence, for example, and try to emulate it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? You didn't get here early because you were nervous?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wh-why, I would never! It's not like I was so elated that I mistook the time or anything!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Anyway, our photo shoot is first, and after that, there's the interview. Correct?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's what I heard… Gahhh, just the idea of getting my picture taken is making me nervous!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm still not sure what pose I should make.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What do I do? I don't want to stand out and look like a weirdo…
choice_data_list: You should let out all of the emotions that are bubbling up inside of you.
How about a pose that shows you've got your rival in mind?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The emotions that are… bubbling up inside of me?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Remember what you said earlier? About feeling fired up whenever you put on your signature racewear?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, yeah! So I should just show off how I'm feeling whenever I have my signature racewear on!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You don't need any accessories for that. You just have to show them you're giving it all you've got, no?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll try to show them my burning hot passion!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My rivals, huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wh-why are you staring at me like that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm just getting a good look at your pose, King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm sure your trainer meant "in mind" as your drive to defeat them, not mimic them!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, I get it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My drive to beat my rivals… All right, that's what I'll try and show 'em!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But this signature racewear is really something special. It fills me with the desire to win.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You're all dear friends to me, but at the same time, you're also my rivals. So I'm gonna run as fast as I can and take first place!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! I accept your challenge. And I'm sure the other three will too.
choice_data_list: Racing against your rivals will push you all to new heights!
Racing against your rivals will push you all to new heights!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Today is just a photo shoot, but we'll all be wearing these same outfits the next time we meet on the turf!
